network_status.network: Bridge collapses in Italy across the 21st century: survey and statistical analysis
network_status.summary_it: Le fonti contemporanee collocano il piccolo ponte su una strada interpoderale adiacente alla SS188 e parlano soltanto di un fiumiciattolo ingrossato; non confermano che l'attraversamento fosse sul Mazaro. ARCUS sospende ogni associazione idrometrica finché il corso d'acqua non è identificato.
network_status.summary_en: Contemporary sources place the small bridge on a farm road beside SS188 and describe only a swollen minor stream; they do not confirm a crossing of the Mazaro. ARCUS suspends hydrometric association until the watercourse is identified.

provenance.method: Manual extraction encoded in the ARCUS event-report curation registry

caveats: The cited source review is complete; no compatible tabulated bridge-section value is assigned.
ARCUS does not digitise plotted hydrographs into false-precision event peaks.
The encoded failure process remains separate from hydrometric evidence.
Rainfall is not converted into stage or discharge.
